fields.name: PhoneNumberChange
fields.fieldText:
This guide will walk you through the proper handling of the Phone Number Change process. By following this guide, all information you've gathered must be recorded in the case.

The Phone Number Change guide addresses concerns such as:

  • Request to change the account's Main, Fax, Additional Number or Digital Line number.
  • Replace a phone number with an existing number on the account; a vanity number; or any available number on the RingCentral database.

NOTE: In the event that you encounter a road block when using this guide, please ask assistance from a Team Lead.

 

Click Next to continue

fields.name: PhoneNumberChange_0_0_1_0
fields.fieldText:
NO AVAILABLE NUMBER

Inform the customer that there are no available numbers based on their current preference.

NOTE: If the customer would like to choose another number from the list availalble in our phone number database, click "Previous". 

If the customer does not wish to proceed into adding the number because of this, inform the customer that we can request from our carriers to get a phone number based on their preference, but there would not be any guarantee on how soon those numbers can be acquired.

NOTE: If the customer would like to request for a specific Toll-free number, select "No", then walk them through on how they can add a vanity number to their account: Article Number : 10066.

fields.name: PhoneNumberChange_0_0_1_1
fields.fieldText:
TEST IF THE NUMBER IS ROUTING CALLS TO RINGCENTRAL

Before making any changes, place a test call to the desired number using inContact and determine if the call is routing to the RingCentral network.

Note: If the number is not routing to the RingCentral network, choose a different number but do not forget to notify your Team Lead or Manager about the previously selected bad number.

Proceed to changing the phone number once the test call successfully routes to the RingCentral network

 

TEST IF THE NEW NUMBER IS WORKING

Place a test call and make sure that the call is being routed properly to the customer's account

CHANGING EXISTING PHONE NUMBERS

Walk the customer through on swapping the phone numbers using the online account by following this guide: Article Number : 3681.

NOTE: Swapping of DigitalLine numbers from local to Toll-Free is not recommended due to the following reasons:

  • True 800 numbers are subject to a one-time fee of $30.00
  • Allotted DigitalLine minutes will not be utilized for both inbound and outbound calls. Toll-Free minutes will be used instead.

fields.fieldText:
SWAPPING NUMBERS WITHIN THE ACCOUNT

Using the Admin Tool, directly swap the desired number with the other number in the same account

NOTE:

  • You cannot directly swap a phone number from one account to another account even if both accounts are owned by the customer
  • In the event that the customer would want to swap a phone number that is on a different account, that phone number must be removed from that particular account first before changing the phone number.

Issue Resolved.
